name: @plandek-utils/graphql-utils
author: Eduardo Turiño <eturino@plandek.com>
description: Small set of utils for GraphQL

scripts.build: npm run build:tsup && npm run build:dts
scripts.check:dist: node --no-experimental-require-module -e "const p=require('./package.json');const m=require(require('node:path').resolve(p.main));if(typeof m.loadTypeDefs!=='function')throw new Error('main ('+p.main+') does not export loadTypeDefs as CommonJS')" && node --input-type=module -e "import {readFileSync} from 'node:fs';import {resolve} from 'node:path';const p=JSON.parse(readFileSync('./package.json','utf8'));const m=await import(resolve(p.module));if(typeof m.loadTypeDefs!=='function')throw new Error('module ('+p.module+') does not export loadTypeDefs')"
scripts.fix: npm run fix:biome && npm run fix:minify
scripts.check: npm run check:biome && npm run check:tsc
scripts.prepare-release: npm run fix && npm run check && npm run test && npm run build
